description: Park bench along X: wooden seat slats and an optional reclined backrest on cast-iron side frames (two, or three on long benches). The seat faces +Z. Pivot at the centre of the base. Pieces: bench_slats (wood), bench_frames (metal_dark). Every piece is closed.

seed.desc: random seed of the slat tint

slat_pts.note: seat slats, then three backrest slats tilted back by 15 degrees

frame_lines.note: per side frame: front leg + seat rail + back leg as one polyline, and the backrest upright

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
